Protocol_name: C.P4.92.x30.76 - STT Exterior Lighting Functional Test V7_EnDe.xls

Test_Suites.name: HEAD LIGHTS, MARKER LIGHTS & TAIL LIGHTS

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Manual control of exterior lights.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the Manual control of exterior lights.
initial_conditions: - External Ambient Light conditions equivalent to Daytime.
- Tail lights are ON at both ends.

test_actions.text:
In CABIN:
- Activate the Cab by changing the Cab Key Switch from "0" to "1" position.

In Active Cab: 
- Headlights OFF
- Tailights ON
- Front Marker Lights & Upper Marker Light OFF

In Non-Active Cab: 
- Headlights OFF
- Tailights ON
- Front Marker Lights & Upper Marker Light OFF
Side Marker Lights are ON

In CABIN:
- Move direction switch from "0" to "1" position

In Active Cab: 
- Headlights OFF
- Tailights ON
- Front Marker Lights & Upper Marker Light OFF

In Non-Active Cab: 
- Headlights OFF
- Tailights ON
- Front Marker Lights & Upper Marker Light OFF
Side Marker Lights are ON

In Active CABIN
- Move direction switch to "V" or "R" position

In Active Cab: 
- Headlights OFF
- Tailights OFF
- Front Marker Lights ON & Upper Marker Light OFF

In Non-Active Cab: 
- Headlights OFF
- Tailights  OFF
- Front Marker Lights & Upper Marker Light OFF
Side Marker Lights are ON

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, press low beam virtual pushbutton to switch ON the Headlights

In Active Cab: 
- Headlights ON with low beam
- Tailights OFF
- Front Marker Lights & Upper Marker Light ON

In Non-Active Cab: 
- Headlights OFF
- Tailights ON
- Front Marker Lights & Upper Marker Light OFF
Side Marker Lights are ON

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton for Headlights HIGH beam (3 seconds)

In Active Cab: 
- Headlights ON with high beam
- Tailights OFF
- Front Marker Lights & Upper Marker Light ON

In Non-Active Cab: 
- Headlights OFF
- Tailights ON
- Front Marker Lights & Upper Marker Light OFF
Side Marker Lights are ON

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton to switch OFF the Headlights

In Active Cab: 
- Headlights OFF
- Tailights OFF
- Front Marker Lights ON & Upper Marker Light OFF

In Non-Active Cab: 
- Headlights OFF
- Tailights OFF
- Front Marker Lights & Upper Marker Light OFF
Side Marker Lights are ON

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, press low beam virtual pushbutton for Headlights HIGH beam

Headlights emit a high beam flash, when PB is held down
Other Lights status also remains unchanged (same as in previous step)

In Active CABIN:
- Move direction switch from "V" or "R" position to "0" position

In Active Cab: 
- Headlights OFF
- Tailights ON
- Front Marker Lights & Upper Marker Light OFF

In Non-Active Cab: 
- Headlights OFF
- Tailights  ON
- Front Marker Lights & Upper Marker Light OFF
Side Marker Lights are ON

In CABIN:
- Deactivate the Cab by changing the Cab Key switch from "1" to "0" position.

In Active Cab: 
- Headlights OFF
- Tailights ON
- Front Marker Lights & Upper Marker Light OFF

In Non-Active Cab: 
- Headlights OFF
- Tailights ON
- Front Marker Lights & Upper Marker Light OFF
Side Marker Lights are OFF

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the tail light illumination (Z6) in Parked vehicle.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the tail light illumination (Z6) in Parked vehicle.

test_actions.text:
In CABIN:
- Activate Z6 switch 76S02.
Left Tail light illuminates in the same (Head) Cab (76H12).

In CABIN:
- Reset Z6 switch 76S02.
Left Tail light (76H12) switches OFF in Head Cab.

In Rear CABIN:
- Activate Z6 switch 76S02 in other side cabin
Right Tail light illuminates in the last (Tail) Cab (76H12) with respect to Head Cabin.

In Rear CABIN:
- Reset Z6 switch 76S02.
Tail light (76H12) switches OFF in Rear Cab.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the functionality of braking lights with master controller in braking.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the functionality of braking lights with master controller in braking.
initial_conditions: - Local Cab is Active and forward direction is selected
- Traction Brake Handle in COASTING position.
- vehicle is at Standstill and Holding Brake is applied.
- Sufficient Track Length available for vehicle movement.
- Emergency Brake 1/2, Emergency Brake 3 and Safety Brake are released.

test_actions.text:
In CABIN:
- Move the vehicle at the speed > 2Km/h
Nothing happens.

In CABIN:
- Command Service Braking from Traction Brake handle.
Rear Brake Light is ON.

In CABIN:
- Move the Traction Brake handle to COASTING position.
Rear Brake Light is OFF.

In CABIN:
- Move the Traction Brake handle to BRAKE position and stop the vehicle.
Rear Brake Light is ON.

In Active CABIN:
- Force the output O_BRAKE=0
Rear Brake Light is OFF.

In Active CABIN:
- Force the output O_BRAKE=1
Rear Brake Light is ON.

In Active CABIN:
- Unforce output O_BRAKE
Rear Brake Light is ON.

Test_Cases.description:

test_actions.text: STEP DELETED

In Passenger Area:
- Activate Passenger Alarm pushbutton (command emergency brake 1/2).
Rear Brake Light is ON.

In Passenger Area:

Rear Brake Light is OFF.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the functionality of braking lights with Emergency  Brake 3
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the functionality of braking lights with Emergency  Brake 3
initial_conditions: - Traction Brake Handle in COASTING position.
- vehicle is at Standstill and Holding Brake is applied.
- Emergency Brake 1/2, Emergency Brake 3 and Safety Brake are released.

test_actions.text: STEP DELETED

In C1 Car:
- Disconnect relay coil 18K03
Nothing happens

In CABIN:
- Move the Traction Brake handle to Emergency Braking (last) position (command emergency brake 3)
Rear Brake Light is ON.
Check Input

In C1 Car:
- Re-connect relay coil 18K03
Rear Brake Light is OFF.

In CABIN:
- Move the Traction Brake handle to COASTING position (reset emergency brake 3)
Rear Brake Light is OFF.
STEP DELETED

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the functionality of Direction lights.
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the functionality of Direction lights.

test_actions.text:
In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton for LEFT direction light.
Lights on the LEFT side of the active cabin start blinking.

In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton for RIGHT direction light.
Lights on the RIGHT side of the active cabin start blinking.

In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton for LEFT direction light again.
Lights on the LEFT side of the active cabin start blinking.

In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton for LEFT direction light again.
Lights switches OFF.

In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton for RIGHT direction light.
Lights on the RIGHT side of the active cabin start blinking.

In CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton for RIGHT direction light again.
Lights switches OFF.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the functionality of Hazard lights.
-Independent of the Battery Contactor Status (ON/OFF)
-Independent of the cabin status (active/inactive)
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check the functionality of Hazard lights.
-Independent of the Battery Contactor Status (ON/OFF)
-Independent of the cabin status (active/inactive)

test_actions.text:
In CABIN:
- Press Hazard Light pushbutton 76S01.
All direction lights are blinking on both sides (left & right).
Hazard Light pushbutton 76S01 is blinking.

In CABIN:
- Reset Hazard Light pushbutton 76S01.
All direction lights and pushbutton light switch OFF.

Test_Cases.name:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check lamps monitoring circuit of Head Lights
Test_Cases.description:
Purpose of the Test CASE
To check lamps monitoring circuit of Head Lights
initial_conditions: - Local Cab is Active and forward direction is selected.

test_actions.text:
In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton to switch ON the Headlights
Head lights switched ON with low beam.

In Active Car:
- Disconnect wire from Relay pin 76K04: 5
Check Input
Check Alarm

In Active Car:
- Re-connect wire in relay socket pin 76K04: 5
Alarm Reset

In Active Car:
- Disconnect wire from Relay pin 76K04: 14
Check Input
Check Alarm

In Active Car:
- Re-connect wire in relay socket pin 76K04: 14
Alarm Reset

In Active CABIN:
- On HMI, press virtual pushbutton to switch OFF the Headlights
Head lights switched OFF.
